annotations.title: Which of these Airbnb house rules are likely not allowed under the policy for reservations booked from 2026-11-20, and how should they be rewritten?

description: Checks pasted short-term-rental house rules / checkout requests (English or Japanese, one per line) against keyword patterns built from Airbnb's help article 4168 and its 2026-10-20 announcement (rules as of 2026-10-28; policy covers reservations booked on or after 2026-11-20). Per rule: likely_flagged (cleaner tasks: washing/putting away dishes, dishwasher, stripping beds, laundry, vacuuming, taking trash off-site; fines, penalties, late-checkout fees, deposit deductions; restricting advertised amenities such as AC or hot tub; separate contracts or waivers; ID / personal info; off-platform apps or forms; new rules by message, sign or in person), review, move_to_section (mandatory fees → Pricing, HOA/local-government fines → Local rules, check-in times), legal_exception (Japan: 宿泊者名簿 guest register and passport copy for foreign guests without a Japan address under 住宅宿泊事業法 art. 8 / 旅館業法 art. 6, if disclosed in Requests before booking), use_standard_rule (max guests, quiet hours, events, pets, smoking, commercial photography, lock up), likely_ok (dishes in the sink, gather towels, sort trash into indoor bins, turn off AC, optional priced add-ons, safety info, local exceptions like bear-proof bins) or no_match. Returns verdict (fix_needed | review_needed | tidy_up | looks_ok), headline, summary, policy {appliesToBookingsFrom, appliesToThisBooking, daysUntilPolicy}, counts, items [{text, finding, reasons, reasonsJa, rewrite, moveTo, japanNote}], standardRulesToSet, japanChecklist (art. 9 explanation duty, minpaku trash is business waste), sources, disclaimer. Use for 'can I still ask Airbnb guests to do dishes / strip beds / take out trash', 'Airbnb house rules change November 2026', 'Airbnb late checkout fee allowed', エアビー ハウスルール 変更, 民泊 パスポート 写し Airbnb. Educational keyword check, likely outcomes only; not affiliated with Airbnb, which decides.

bookingDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD date the reservation was booked (policy covers bookings on or after 2026-11-20).

channel.description: Where guests see the rules: listing (default, House rules and requests) | message | sign | in_person. Outside the listing can't add new rules.

jurisdiction.description: JP (default) adds Japan legal exceptions (guest register, passport copy) and notes; other = generic.

lodging.description: Japan licence: minpaku (住宅宿泊事業法) | ryokan (旅館業法: hotel, ryokan, 簡易宿所) | unknown (default).

text.description: House rules / requests to check, one per line (English or Japanese). Max 8000 chars, 80 rules.
